Bosun, the senior officer of the ship's company, usually one of the sea-keepers and most often the ship's cook. He is responsible for the keeping order on deck when the captain or mate is not there to maintain it. He is often referred to as ‘the skipper’. The word was originally applied only to the master's mate (or first lieutenant of the crew).
